title: Matching the lighting in sample photos
titleZh: 讓樣品照片維持一致光線
passage:
Do you want me to raise the blinds so the samples look brighter in the photographs?
A. I want this set to match the morning shots. The desk lamp was our only light then.
B. The printer made the pictures from this morning look darker than they did on the screen.
C. We can compare all the samples once the photographs are in order.
passageZh:
要不要把百葉窗拉起來，讓照片中的樣品看起來亮一點？
A. 我想讓這組和早上拍的相符。當時唯一的光源是桌燈。
B. 早上的照片印出來比在螢幕上看時更暗。
C. 照片排好順序後，我們就能比較所有樣品。
